decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the three articles and the designer-controlled placement rule; no additional change or removal is required.
The existing same-message Event already requires completing the table of contents after issue content and pagination are finalized. Adding these articles does not change that completion condition.
Adding articles does not alter the existing rule for identifying text-heavy articles and requesting additional visual material when needed.
The existing attribution requirement already applies to every article, so the newly required articles are covered without changing the requirement state.
The added issue content does not change the required digital flipbook deliverable.
The conditional image-enhancement rule remains valid unchanged and already applies wherever image enhancement is needed.
The source adds required articles but does not modify the digital launch target or deadline.
Consistency with cover-listed content concerns issue inclusion, not the magazine's visual-style, branding, or color constraints.
